hadith:
Good Manners and Form (Al-Adab) - Narrated Anas:

I served the Prophet (ﷺ) for ten years, and he never said to me, "Uf" (a minor harsh word denoting impatience) and never blamed me by saying, "Why did you do so or why didn't you do so?"
message: Allah, the Greatest (Al Kabeer), created the heavens and earth with perfect purpose, reminding us of His infinite power and majesty—yet He teaches us through the Prophet Muhammad's gentle patience to treat others with kindness and respect, never hastening to blame or criticize. By recognizing Allah's greatness and embodying compassionate character in our dealings, we align ourselves with the teachings of our faith and fulfill the purpose of our creation.
name:
Al Kabeer - الْكَبِيرُ - The Greatest

The term Al Kabeer highlights Allah's unparalleled magnitude, authority, and grandeur, reminding believers of His infinite power and majesty. The name originates from the Arabic root 'K-B-R,' meaning 'to be great or to be large.' It is found in various Islamic texts, emphasizing the significance of recognizing Allah's greatness in worship and daily life.
verse:
Ibrahim - Abraham - 14:19

Have you not seen that Allah created the heavens and the earth for a reason? If He wills, He can eliminate you and produce a new creation.
